components.title: Calculate target date
components.what: Starting Monday 2026-03-16: through Friday 2026-07-24 there are 19 full weeks (95 weekdays) minus 6 listed holidays = 88 business days. Day 89 is Monday 2026-07-27.

log.author: D
log.draft:
2026-03-14 is a Saturday (verify with a date library or 2026 calendar: 2026-01-01 is Thursday, so Mar 14 is Saturday). The first business day after it is Monday 2026-03-16.

From Monday 2026-03-16 through Friday 2026-07-24 inclusive there are 95 weekdays. The six listed holidays all fall on weekdays in that range: 2026-03-20 Fri, 2026-03-26 Thu, 2026-04-30 Thu, 2026-06-10 Wed, 2026-06-11 Thu, 2026-07-16 Thu. So business days = 95 - 6 = 89.

Thus the 89th business day after 2026-03-14 is Friday 2026-07-24, not Monday 2026-07-27. The earlier “88 business days” figure is an arithmetic error.

FINAL: 2026-07-24

challenges.problem: The count of weekdays from Monday 2026-03-16 through Friday 2026-07-24 inclusive is 95, but the calendar calculation needs re-verifying: 2026-03-16 to 2026-07-24 is exactly 19 full weeks (19 * 7 = 133 days; 133 - 1 = 132? March 16 to July 24 is: March has 16 days [16..31], April 30, May 31, June 30, July 24 = 131 days). 131 days / 7 = 18 weeks and 5 days. Monday to Friday across 18 full weeks plus Mon-Fri of the 19th week is (18 * 5) + 5 = 95 weekdays. Subtracting 6 holidays leaves 89 business days. The draft's arithmetic appears fully sound, leaving no valid counter-date.

log.answer:
2026-03-14 is a Saturday. The first business day after it is Monday 2026-03-16.

Count weekdays from Monday 2026-03-16 through Friday 2026-07-24 inclusive: this span is 131 calendar days (16 in March, 30 April, 31 May, 30 June, 24 July), i.e., 18 full weeks plus 5 extra days (Mon-Fri). That gives 18*5 + 5 = 95 weekdays. All six holidays (2026-03-20 Fri, 2026-03-26 Thu, 2026-04-30 Thu, 2026-06-10 Wed, 2026-06-11 Thu, 2026-07-16 Thu) fall within this range on weekdays, so business days = 95 - 6 = 89.

Thus 89 business days after 2026-03-14 lands on Friday 2026-07-24.

FINAL: 2026-07-24
